name: swarm
description: Structured Workflows for Autonomous Role Management.

interface.shortDescription: Control a coordinated Codex team from one task
interface.longDescription: SWARM is an open-source control plane for Codex. Route bounded work to in-task helpers or durable lanes, preserve human authority, and prove each result with the smallest sufficient independent acceptance path.
defaultPrompt: Use SWARM to organize this outcome with clear ownership, canonical state, and independent review.
